title: Identity at environmental scale
slide_intent: Show the mark in a crowded physical setting because recognition must survive beyond a clean presentation board.
strategic_value: A large, simple symbol can remain identifiable amid people, architecture and bright outdoor light.
demonstration: A red-and-yellow mark and white wordmark occupy a dark wall beside a snowy public gathering.
practical_value: Compare environmental prominence with the small acceptance sticker in MC07.

content_islands.name: Setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the full snowy crowd, blue sky and diagonal building edge.

content_islands.name: Brand surface
content_islands.spec: Place the large overlapping circles over the white wordmark on the dark wall at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph places the identity on a large exterior wall at a public venue.
